label: Represented esse map into the shared principle type
definition: The q3a4 profile projects an esseOf map from each bearer to a represented principle value. It shares its codomain with essenceOf. The composition-kinds reading compares the values of the two supplied maps at the same bearer.
note: The profile also supplies a separate esse respect used in act and cause predicates. Comparing esseOf with essenceOf uses values in the shared principle type.
